description:
Music video directed by Masatsugu Nagasoe for the song Spunky Afro Tiger Jet by Tigarah e Laura.

Tigarah e Laura is an artist with faces of an angel and a devil. In this project, the two characters embody her opposite qualities – Tigarah for her demonic side, and Laura, for her angelic side. Through the characters, Tigarah e Laura and her creative team show a unique performance by integrating music, cartoons, fashion and dance.

(Source: YouTube video description)
